dialogue.content: 相談員です。宜しくお願い致します！
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. It's a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.content: 本日はよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Thank you for speaking with me today.

dialogue.content: 17時より開始いたします。
dialogue.English: We will begin at 5:00 PM.

dialogue.content: 承知いたしました
dialogue.English: Understood.

dialogue.content: 相談員です。宜しくお願い致します。それではまず、ご年齢、性別、なんとお呼びすれば良いか教えて貰えますか？
dialogue.English: Hello, this is the counselor. It's a pleasure to speak with you. To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like me to call you?

dialogue.content: お願いします。16歳です。女子です。ミキでお願いします。
dialogue.English: Of course. I'm 16 years old and female. Please call me Miki.

dialogue.content: みきさんですね。お願いします。今日はどうなさいましたか？
dialogue.English: Miki, correct? Thank you. What brings you in today?

dialogue.content: クラスの子に、突然、無視されるようになってしまいました
dialogue.English: My classmates suddenly started ignoring me.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいか分からなくて困っています
dialogue.English: I don't know what to do, and I'm really struggling.

dialogue.content: 突然、無視されているのですか。。お辛いですね。。もう少し詳しくお聞きしても良いですか？
dialogue.English: They're suddenly ignoring you? That must be really tough. Would it be alright if I asked you for a few more details?

dialogue.content: いつも一緒にお昼ご飯を食べてるグループの子たちといつも通りご飯をしようとお弁当を持っていつもの机の場所に行ったんです。
dialogue.English: I brought my lunch and went to our usual table to eat with the group of friends I always have lunch with.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 私が近づいたら、先にいたみんなが突然机を動かして、私の席がなくなるように座ったんです
dialogue.English: As I approached, the others who were already there suddenly moved the desks and sat in a way that left no seat for me.

dialogue.content: それで、「食べよ〜」って普通に。
dialogue.English: And then they just said, "Let's eat," like it was nothing.

dialogue.content: なんと、、突然そんな事をされたのですね。。それはお辛いですね。。
dialogue.English: Oh my... For them to do something like that so suddenly... That must have been so painful.

dialogue.content: びっくりしました
dialogue.English: I was shocked.

dialogue.content: 訳分からなくて…
dialogue.English: I couldn't make sense of it...

dialogue.content: 本当にこういうことってあるんだって思いました
dialogue.English: It made me think, "So this kind of thing really does happen."

dialogue.content: 驚きますよね、、辛かったですね、、何か原因は思い当たりますか？
dialogue.English: It's shocking, isn't it... That must have been so hard... Can you think of any reason why this might have happened?

dialogue.content: 全然思い当たらないんです
dialogue.English: I can't think of anything at all.

dialogue.content: いじめっていうか、無視って本当にこんなに突然始まるんだなって思いました
dialogue.English: It made me realize that bullying, or being ignored, can really start so suddenly.

dialogue.content: 漫画みたいだなって
dialogue.English: It felt like something out of a manga.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね、、理由がないのは、納得もいかないですよね。本当にとつぜんだったのですね、。
dialogue.English: I see... It must be hard to accept when there's no reason. It really was completely sudden, wasn't it?

dialogue.content: 相談出来る人はいますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anyone you can talk to about this?

dialogue.content: はい、本当に突然でした
dialogue.English: Yes, it was completely sudden.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 高校の違う親友には相談ではないけれど、事情は話しました
dialogue.English: I haven't really asked for advice, but I told my best friend, who goes to a different high school, about the situation.

dialogue.content: 親友の方があるのですね。心強いです。親友はなんとおっしゃってましたか？
dialogue.English: So you have a best friend you can talk to. That's reassuring. What did she say?

dialogue.content: ミキ大丈夫？って心配してくれてます
dialogue.English: She's worried about me, asking, "Miki, are you okay?"

dialogue.content: 親友の方が不安にさせちゃってて、申し訳ないです
dialogue.English: I feel bad for making my best friend worry.

dialogue.content: 心配してくれているのですね。でも逆に心配かけて申し訳なさを感じているのですね。。みきさんは相手の気持ちにしっかりなれるからこそ、そう感じてしまうのですね。。
dialogue.English: So she's worried about you, but in turn, you feel sorry for making her worry. It's because you're so considerate of other people's feelings that you feel this way.

dialogue.content: クラスには相談出来る子はいますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anyone in your class you can talk to?

dialogue.content: クラスにはいないです他の子もみんな見て見ぬ振りじゃないかと思います
dialogue.English: There's no one in my class. I think the other kids are just pretending not to notice.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。。辛い中、一人で戦っているのですね。今日相談できた事はとても良い判断ですよ。先生、親は知ってますか？
dialogue.English: I see. You're facing this alone in such a tough situation. Reaching out for help today was a very good decision. Do your teachers or parents know?

dialogue.content: 先生は知らないと思います。先生ら授業中の何もない様子しか知らないから。親にも言ってません。
dialogue.English: I don't think my teachers know. They only see me during class when nothing is happening. I haven't told my parents either.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。。1人でつからったですね。。本当によく相談してくれましたね。因みにその一件はいつあったのでしたっけ？また、それ以外に何かされた事はありますか？
dialogue.English: I see... It must have been so hard dealing with this on your own. Thank you so much for reaching out to talk about it. By the way, when did that incident happen? And has anything else happened besides that?

dialogue.content: 2週間くらい前です
dialogue.English: It was about two weeks ago.

dialogue.content: お昼ご飯のことがあってから、私からみんなに近寄らないようにしています
dialogue.English: Ever since that incident at lunchtime, I've been avoiding them.

dialogue.content: なので、特に何かされたりはしてないです
dialogue.English: So, nothing else has really happened.

dialogue.content: なんと、2週間まえから辛い思いをしてたのですね。。本当に辛かったと思います。。学校に行くのは苦痛ではなかったですか？
dialogue.English: Oh, so you've been going through this for two weeks now. I can only imagine how difficult that must have been. Has going to school been painful?

dialogue.content: すごくしんどいです
dialogue.English: It's been really tough.

dialogue.content: 行きも帰りも元々1人だし、授業は話すこともないからいいんですけど、授業の間の休憩中とか、お昼ご飯の時間が辛いです
dialogue.English: I go to and from school alone anyway, and classes are fine since there's no need to talk, but the breaks between classes and lunchtime are tough.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。。1人の時間は辛いですよね。。何もしていないはずなのに、こんな事になってどうすれば良いかも分からないですよね。。ここまでの状況をまとめると、
dialogue.English: I understand... Being alone can be very painful. And you haven't done anything wrong, yet this is happening, and you don't know what to do. To summarize the situation so far,

dialogue.content: みきさんは、何もしていないのに、食事の際に避けられたり、見て見ぬ振りをされている状況で間違いないですよね？
dialogue.English: Miki, you've done nothing wrong, but you're being avoided during meals and others are pretending not to notice you, is that correct?

dialogue.content: そうです、みんなが何を思ったのかは知らないけど、私的には何もしてないつもりです
dialogue.English: That's right. I don’t know what they're thinking, but as far as I’m concerned, I didn’t do anything.

dialogue.content: 私の何がみんなを怒らせたんだろう…
dialogue.English: I wonder what I did to make everyone so angry...

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。何か分かれば、一番良いですよね。。みきさんはこの先どうしていきたいですか？一緒に最善策を考えていきましょう。
dialogue.English: I agree. It would be best if you could find out the reason. Miki, what would you like to see happen from here? Let's think about the best way forward together.

dialogue.content: クラス替えまでかなり期間が長いし、クラス替えしてもほとんどメンバー変わらないので、このままだとずっとしんどいから、表面上だけでいいから元に戻りたいです
dialogue.English: It's a long time until our classes are changed, and even then, most of the members will be the same. It's going to be hard to continue like this, so I want things to go back to how they were, even if it's just on the surface.

dialogue.content: 私はみんなのこともう好きになれないけど、上辺だけで付き合ってくくらいならできるから
dialogue.English: I can't like them anymore, but I can manage a superficial relationship.

dialogue.content: でもどうしたらいいか分からない。みんな性格キツいから、話しかけるのも怖くて…
dialogue.English: But I don't know what to do. They all have strong personalities, so I’m scared to even talk to them...

dialogue.content: 先生には頼りたくないし、かと言って他に頼れそうな人もいない
dialogue.English: I don't want to rely on the teachers, but there's no one else I feel I can turn to.

dialogue.content: 何かいい方法とかありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there any good way to handle this?

dialogue.content: 表面だけでも普通に戻りたいのですね。そう考える事は普通の考えですよね。話しかけることは怖いですよね。。それも誰だってそう思いますよね。
dialogue.English: You’d like things to return to normal, even just on the surface. That’s a very understandable way to think. It’s scary to approach them—anyone would feel that way.

dialogue.content: いい方法ですね。。少し待ってくださいね。
dialogue.English: A good way... Please give me a moment to think.

dialogue.content: はい、すみません、お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, sorry, please do.

dialogue.content: 先生にも頼りたくないのは、どの様な気持ちからですか？
dialogue.English: What makes you feel reluctant to seek help from a teacher?

dialogue.content: うーん、あんまり大人を巻き込みたくないっていうか。先生に助けてもらうと、みんなから余計に嫌われそう。漫画とかでも先生にチクったとかでひどくなるのとかもあったから、ちょっと嫌です。
dialogue.English: Hmm, I don’t really want to involve adults. If I get a teacher’s help, I feel like everyone will hate me even more. In manga and stuff, it often gets worse when someone “snitches” to a teacher, so I’m not comfortable with that.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。お気持ちはすごくわかります。話してくれてありがとうございます。因みに一旦、親御さんに相談する事についてはどう考えますか？
dialogue.English: I see... I can really understand how you feel. Thank you for sharing that with me. By the way, what are your thoughts on talking to your parents about this?

dialogue.content: んー、親は厳しくて、今までも学校に行きたくない日でも行かされてきたから、相談しても、それでも行きなさいって言われそうで嫌です。
dialogue.English: Hmm, my parents are strict. Even on days I didn't want to go to school, they've always made me go. So if I tell them, I'm afraid they'll just say, "You still have to go."

dialogue.content: せめてみんながなんで怒ってるのか知りたいです。分かれば直すのに。
dialogue.English: At the very least, I want to know why everyone is angry. If I knew, I would fix it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。。親御さんにも相談出来ない中で、辛かったですね。本当に今日相談したからて良かったです。そうですよね。。知りたいですよね。。でも知るためには誰かに聞く以外方法は思いつきますか？
dialogue.English: I see... It must have been so difficult, not being able to talk to your parents either. I'm really glad you decided to talk about it today. Yes, you want to know the reason. But can you think of any way to find out other than asking someone?

dialogue.content: うーん、思いつかないです
dialogue.English: Hmm, I can't think of anything.

dialogue.content: やっぱり直接聞くのが早いですよね…
dialogue.English: I guess asking them directly would be the quickest way, right...

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。その一件が起こる前に一番話しやすかった子はいたりしますか？
dialogue.English: That's true. Was there anyone in the group who was easiest to talk to before this happened?

dialogue.content: あ、います。今は向こうのグループにいるけど…
dialogue.English: Oh, yes, there is. But she's with their group now...

dialogue.content: いるのですね。それは良かったです。携帯電話とかでその子に連絡取ることとかは出来たりしますか？
dialogue.English: So there is someone. That's good. Would you be able to contact her, perhaps on her phone?

dialogue.content: はい、LINE送れます
dialogue.English: Yes, I can send her a LINE message.

dialogue.content: その子に今、辛い気持ちを素直に話せそうですか？原因を聞くためにはその子に聞くことが一番聞きやすいですかね？
dialogue.English: Do you feel you could honestly tell her how difficult this has been for you? To find out the reason, would she be the easiest person to ask?

dialogue.content: うーん、1番怒ってるのはその子じゃなさそうな気がするから、たぶん1番聞きやすいと思います。
dialogue.English: Hmm, I don't think she's the one who's most angry, so she'd probably be the easiest person to ask.

dialogue.content: みんななんで怒ってるのって聞いていいのかな…
dialogue.English: I wonder if it's okay to ask, "Why is everyone angry?"...

dialogue.content: 聞いて良いか、不安ですよね。。でも、まずは、今の状況が凄く辛くて、もし自分が直せることがあれば直したいから、何か分かったら教えて、と聞いてみても良いと思います。聞けそうですか？
dialogue.English: You're anxious about whether it's okay to ask, aren't you? But I think you could start by telling her that this situation is very difficult for you, and that if there's something you can fix, you want to fix it, so you're asking her to please let you know if she knows anything. Do you think you could ask that?

dialogue.content: そっか、そういう風に聞けばいいんですね
dialogue.English: Oh, I see. So that's how I should ask.

dialogue.content: 頑張ってみます
dialogue.English: I'll try my best.

dialogue.content: 参考になって良かったです。みきさんの勇気ある行動が必ず現状を抜け出す行動になるはずです！心から応援してますよ。
dialogue.English: I’m glad that was helpful. Your courageous action will surely be what helps you get out of this situation. I’m truly rooting for you.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます聞き方を教えてもらったらちょっとだけ安心しました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. Now that you've told me how to ask, I feel a little more at ease.

dialogue.content: どうにかしたいから、頑張ってLINEしてみます
dialogue.English: I want to fix this, so I'll do my best and send her a LINE message.

dialogue.content: 安心できたのも、みきさんの勇気ある相談の結果です。誰かに頼る力はとても大切なことですからね。今日はありがとうございました。また、何かあればいつでも相談してくださいね。それでは終了の定型文を送りますね。今日はありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Feeling more at ease is a result of your courage in seeking help today. The ability to rely on others is very important. Thank you for your time today. If anything else comes up, please don't hesitate to reach out. Now, I will send the standard closing message. Thank you for today!

dialogue.content: （さくらさん、ありがとうございました。時間オーバーしてすみません。感じた事を厳しくフィードバックして貰えればとおもいます！ありがとうございました！）
dialogue.English: (Sakura-san, thank you very much. I’m sorry for going over time. I would appreciate your candid and critical feedback on your impressions. Thank you!)

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました！また上手くいかなかったら相談にきます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you so much! If it doesn't go well, I'll come back to talk again.

dialogue.content: 終了します！
dialogue.English: Ending the session now!

dialogue.content: (こちらこそ、本日はありがとうございました！時間は全然大丈夫です。はい、しっかりとフィードバックさせていただきます。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well for today! The time was no problem at all. Yes, I will provide thorough feedback.)
